_question: Floppy disks (v4): does each essential state change keep an equivalent non-motion communication under reduced motion? Mappings are from the full-motion carrier to the reduced carrier.

mappings.full: the boot's logo travels up into the page logo's place over 620 ms; the words fade; the chrome fades in after
mappings.reduced: the boot screen is removed at once; the page is already in place; the status line has announced progress and 'Ready'

mappings.full: the disks rise into the box from the gap out, and the camera settles
mappings.reduced: the box is shown full, the camera at rest

mappings.full: each disk passing the gap leans over on its own spring and stops against its neighbours with a small bounce; the logo and caption fade
mappings.reduced: leans are set at once; the position number and the index row change immediately

mappings.full: the current disk slides up out of the box along its own plane, then floats to the presentation spot, square to the viewer (gated springs)
mappings.reduced: the gate sequence resolves within one frame; the disk is shown presented

mappings.full: the logo opens from its centre line outward over 640 ms; the caption fades in
mappings.reduced: the logo and caption appear at once; the status region announces the disk in both modes

mappings.full: the shutter slides, the disk turns on its side and slides into the drive slot on the sheet's edge; the sheet slides in from the right
mappings.reduced: the sheet is shown at once; focus moves to Eject

mappings.full: the drive light flickers; the README's blocks come up in order, 22 ms apart, once the disk is in and the text has arrived
mappings.reduced: the README is shown as soon as the text has arrived; there is no disk to wait for

mappings.full: the disk slides out of the slot, turns upright, the shutter closes; the sheet waits 260 ms, then slides away
mappings.reduced: the sheet is removed at once; focus returns to where it was

mappings.full: the index fades in over the page in 160 ms; logos draw into their rows as they scroll into view
mappings.reduced: the index appears at once; focus moves to Find

mappings.full: on filter or sort, the disks sink under the floor, re-slot unseen and rise from the gap out
mappings.reduced: slots change in place at once; the index shows the new order

mappings.full: decorative only: every 15 to 40 s the page inverts for two flashes inside 170 ms, with a hiss if sound is on
mappings.reduced: never shown; nothing is lost, because the flicker communicates nothing
